description:
A unofficial player for YouTube Music on desktop

A unofficial player for YouTube Music on desktop which includes a number of additional features to improve the desktop experience of YouTube Music.
What's Changed
General improvements and fixes to the app
Fixed
- Fix for changes to YouTube Music preventing the app from loading
  - Technical reason Recent changes in YTM have hidden more APIs which we utilize other hooking methods to re-obtain.
- Fixes for Continue where you left off when a now unavailable video is loaded.
  - Note: If you are signed into a Google account for YTM you should not need this feature anymore as Google will save your last video and across mobile devices.
Miscellaneous
- Upgrade dependencies
Full Changelog: v2.0.11...v2.0.12
